assessment: The study demonstrates that utilizing the LFP and/or the CSD in modeling can facilitate model configuration and implementation by revealing discrepancies between models and experiments. The analysis of the biophysical origin of the canonical CSD using the model is an interesting and worthy line of investigation. The dissection of CSD components is detailed and exhaustive. A key novelty of this article is the addition of CSD patterns as another constraint to more accurately infer the model parameters beyond its prior state.
